lines.2: She took my hand and pulled me along.
lines.3: 「We are coming to the stairs. Watch your step.」
lines.5: 「Honestly. You are a danger to yourself.」
lines.6: She caught me firmly around the shoulders.
lines.14: 「How did you ever manage on your own until now?」
lines.18: 「You know the red thread of fate? If nobody can see it, how do they know it's red? What if it's green? Doesn't that piss you off?」
lines.20: 「Sounds like you're properly awake. See you at school.」
lines.21: 「This guy was the one looking after me.」
lines.22: 「...Honestly. What exactly is the relationship between you and Date?」
lines.23: 「I truly am glad I came here.」
lines.24: 「I will manage you from now on. Tell Date to focus on his morning track practice.」
lines.26: 「I told you: I have disciplinary-committee duties. If you are late, I will show no mercy.」
